title: Hadithi (Theme 13: Heshima kwa tamaduni za wengine)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the hadithi in its kind and occasion, explains its wahusika with an example, and presents it with the audience taking part.

floor.prerequisite: Tells a riddle or a story with the formula.
floor.question: Kitendawili! - ?

representations: a recording or a performance of "Mzee Busara na wageni kutoka ng'ambo"
steps: Listen to or read the text.
Explain its wahusika with an example.
contexts: an evening of stories at home

board.do: Mzee Busara na wageni kutoka ng'ambo
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child presents a short piece with the class responding.

misconceptions.ask: Utungo unamhusu nani tangu mwanzo hadi mwisho?
misconceptions.repair: Mhusika mkuu ni yule ambaye utungo unamhusu.

misconceptions.ask: Ni kitendo gani kinaonyesha sifa hii?
misconceptions.repair: Thibitisha sifa kwa kitendo au maneno ya mhusika.

misconceptions.ask: Unamjua mtu mwenye tabia kama hii?
misconceptions.repair: Wahusika wanyama huwakilisha tabia za watu.
Funzo hutokana na matokeo ya matendo ya mhusika.

checks.question: Mhusika mkuu katika hadithi hii ni nani?
Katika hadithi, Mzee Busara anawakilisha nini?
checks.answer: watu wenye tabia kama zake katika jamii
